mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the lining and blood route together was most worthwhile: the villus cutaway showed why folds, thin walls and nearby capillaries help absorption.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying glucose with the blood route was frustrating because the need to join the route to the lining first wasn't obvious.

surprise.text: I expected capillaries to combine directly with the lining, but they first needed a completed route to the liver.

arbitrary.text: Combining glucose and amino acids already in blood felt a little arbitrary. The hint identified the pairing, but I didn't understand why it was needed until the shared outgoing vein was shown.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the folded surface and then following nutrients across it made the biology understandable, although I hope the next chapter makes prerequisites clearer.
